newsitem.title: UK: BTR buys Chinese battery firm.
newsitem.headline: BTR buys Chinese battery firm.

text.p: BTR Plc said on Thursday that its unit Hawker Batteries has agreed to buy China's Hwadar Power Supply Company for 23 million stg.
It said in a statement that the purchase of Hwadar establishes a strong market position and a new manufacturing and customer base in China for Hawker Batteries.
BTR said that Hwadar, based in Shenzhen near Hong Kong, is China's leading supplier of valve regulated lead acid standby batteries.

The Anglo-Australian diversified manufacturer also announced that its valves business has invested 4.3 million stg to increase its stake in Sao Paulo-based Worcester Brazil to 80 percent from 20 percent. Worcester Brazil manufactures valves and actuators for the South American market.
